o: Polly Pocket and friends are traveling our world and dimensions beyond — from Brazil to Unicorn World to Skatesville! They’ll be exploring new pocket-sized worlds, rescuing animals in Littleton and beyond, and helping their favorite dance star as she takes the stage in Rio de Janeiro. Through each episode, they’re discovering that every new place is filled with potential new friends and fun!

eps.o: In our season opener, Polly and friends discover a lost cat belonging to Eva, a famous Brazilian dancer. To reunite cat and owner, they must venture to Rio de Janeiro where Eva lives! Our heroes travel in a magical plane, but Polly lands them in stormy skies when she tries to bottle up her big feelings about Shani’s choice to potentially go to a new school!

Picking up from last episode, Polly and our heroes race across Rio to reunite Torta (the cat) with her owner, Eva, but seem to just miss Eva every time! Torta despairs that Eva must have already replaced her, striking fear in Polly and Shani about their friendship if Shani were to change schools. As Polly and Shani navigate their fears, our heroes rush to save Torta and Eva’s relationship.

When the gang meets Morango, a dog who dreams of being an acai bowl chef, Lila decides she’ll help him open an acai bowl shop that will take Rio by storm! But instead of helping with his vision, Lila gets caught up in her own vision, which turns to disaster when a food critic arrives… will Lila realize that helping others achieve their dream means focusing on them, not herself?

Lila, Polly, and Shani deliver a box containing Eva’s special tiara, but when Eva opens the box, the tiara is missing! Nic steps in as detective, using all the skills he learned from mystery podcasts to interrogate each potential tiara-loser (Polly, Shani, and Lila). As he does, we see reenactments of each girl’s day, from Lila’s fashion fiasco to Polly’s journey of snowball near misses. Nic’s…

When Eva sees a negative comment about her solo dance performance, she’s determined to “fix” it before opening night. Polly and friends take Eva for a day in Rio to find inspiration so she can make her solo into something that EVERYONE will love! But as they explore the city, the crew starts to realize that perhaps there’s no such thing as perfect art that EVERYONE can agree upon…

Shani must decide between science school and performing arts school, but she has no idea which one she should pick! Overwhelmed trying to decide which will be best, she pushes a button in Polly’s plane that uses pockite power to send her to alternate futures! Each one shows her incredible versions of what her life could be like on different paths… But picking from a slew of great choices might…

Polly is a whiz when it comes to pet matchmaking, so when neighborhood curmudgeon Mr. Quidnunc visits the Adoption Center, Polly knows exactly what pet will suit him. Despite his interest in a very hyper dog, Polly is confident she knows better and proceeds to match Mr Quidnunc with an array of pets. But when no match works, Polly must challenge her incorrect assumptions about Mr. Quidnunc’s life.

It’s the weekend of the big Kerpow tournament! Lila and Bella’s JV team will perform a “showcase” whereas the varsity team will compete in real competitions. Lila wants to compete for real and decides to try out for the varsity team only to learn that she’s not eligible until she’s 15-years-old. Lila gets an idea: she’ll use her transformation pockite to transform into her very-not-real but…

Jake paints what he thinks is a “cooler” version of himself. When he accidentally brings it to life, Polly helps him wrangle the false Jake. As they chase the false Jake over town, Jake is pushed outside his comfort zone and made to do things he would normally be too scared to do, like perform at a comedy shows! He soon realizes that the real Jake is cooler than he thought.

eps.t: Sunny, With a Chance of Pterodactyls
eps.o: Lila practices tirelessly to perfect a new soccer move, even when coach Sunny Moon tells her to take a break. But when Sunny accidentally turns into a pterodactyl and flies away, Lila is forced to leave the soccer pitch and help find her. It’s only when Lila takes a break to fully focus on finding Sunny that the soccer move finally clicks which she uses to save the day against a teams of LARPers.

Too nervous to bake a dessert for his dad’s girlfriend, Dana, Nic goes to Cocoa Kingdom with Polly for a dessert pickup. Their visit is interrupted by a deadly chocolate volcano that’s about to erupt, forcing Nic and Polly to find a solution before the Cocoa Kingdom becomes a chocolatey version of Pompei! When the eruption becomes a tasty delight, Nic changes his mind and decides to try to bake…

Nic sneaks his pet frog Sally into his dad’s (Hector) and his girlfriend’s (Dana) new house. But when Dana’s beloved cat Dulce meets Sally, it’s a disaster! Their rivalry causes chaos in the house, and Dulce gets so upset she runs away. Nic and his friends race to find Dulce, get her home, and put the house back together, all before Hector and Dana return from their dinner date.

Shani is excited about becoming a big sister to Saryah, the baby her parents have adopted, but Shani's quest to be super prepared for Saryah coming home goes awry when pocket-sized Shani gets stuck in the diaper bag. She must find a way to get back to her regular form before her parents discover her in the bag!

It’s Take Your Favorite Toy to School Day for Pax, and Polly’s Mom has charged Polly with making sure Pax gets to preschool with his favorite stuffed panda. But when Polly gets the panda dirty, she sneaks it into the wash so her mom won’t realize she messed up… and the panda gets lost in the dryer! Polly tracks the lost panda to the Lost and Found pocket world, but finds it’s been ruined by the…

Gilda invites Polly to Sparkle Cove to see a beautiful pockite meteor shower, but they discover that a GIANT meteor made up of a strange type of pockite is headed right for them! Gilda, who claimed she knew everything about pockite, is forced to admit there is much more to learn and turns to her friends for their help. With the comet inverting their existing pockite powers, they must use new…

The Yum Yum Yummy Pet Food Company comes to Littleton to find their next spokespet! After a tough first round, Lila and Bonita are chosen as the finalists and are set to compete at Littleton Stadium through the Yum Yum Yummy Pet Food Obstacle Course! Wanting to prove that Bonita is the best pet ever, Lila modifies the course to make it harder, but this causes Bonita to have doubts about becoming…

When Shani’s parents cancel their long-standing Presidential Tea Party because they’re too busy with the new baby, Polly takes her to a place where fun things never get canceled: Unicorn Land! There she tries her hand at official Presicorn duties which include performing a traditional unicorn dance at her inaugural ball and running the unicorn nursery. But when the duties become too much. Shani…

Polly wants to have a Castles & Unicorns adventure with just her and Pierce, but her parents want to join in. Polly reluctantly agrees but decides they should split the party into two groups to divide and conquer! But when Pierce gets captured, Polly must work with her parents to save him. To her surprise, her parents are amazing at the game!

Polly, Pierce, and Jake discover a new pocket dimension: Skatesville! In this realm filled with ramps and half pipes; Polly, Pierce, and Jake befriend a hamster skater named Axel. Pierce takes it upon himself to make Axel the star of an epic skate video, but he gets a little lost in his own “artistic vision” threatening to ruin her debut at a skate video festival.

When Dana starts moving Dulce’s things around to make room in their house for Nic’s boxes, Dulce acts out and decides that she’s no longer going to compete in the cat show. Wanting to help, Nic steps in and offers to use pockite to take Dulce’s place. Though Dulce is super jealous and tries to sabotage Nic’s chances in the show, she learns that Nic isn’t trying to replace her – he just loves…

After her diabetes diagnosis, Lila designs a jumpsuit with enough pockets to keep all her medical supplies. Not only does it work perfectly, but it’s also very stylish… so stylish that a local designer, Ellie Gantz, steals the design. Lila is okay with not getting the credit, but she wishes that other people with diabetes knew why she made it in the first place. Lila must make a difficult choice…

Run off her feet after a long day of adoptions and a fundraiser, Jake surprises Polly with an epic challenge: finding a home for a puppy with superpowers! Polly assumes a pocket world will be the best match, but Pup’s powers cause trouble in all of them. If none of the pocket worlds are right for the Super Pup, could the perfect home be right under Polly’s nose?

The first day of the ski season at the Rocky Tocky Mountains is canceled after a Yeti has been seen around the ski lodge! Polly, Nic and surprise cryptid expert Irene set out to find and re-home the yeti but have to contend with a gaggle of bumbling cryptid seekers, an ice-cold trail, and worst of all: Nic and Irene’s misconceptions about the yeti’s true nature!

While recording Shani’s demo with her friends forming the back up band, Shani and friends discover a portal to a musical pocket world. But then a diva bullfrog magically steals Shani’s singing voice! As they try to get her voice back, Shani learns that being a good band leader means making sure everyone is playing to their strengths to get the best sound they can get.

Grandma is staying over at the Pocket household the night before she teaches her very first parkour class, but she can’t sleep because Polly forgot to pack her special tea! She and Polly search through various pocket worlds to track down her chamomile tea, eventually finding Ned who runs off with the very last box. While Grandma leads Polly on a parkour-filled chase, she realizes that is may be…

Melody has asked Polly, Shani, and Lila to spend the day before her concert doing something spectacular! Melody wants to show her friends how exciting a rock star's life can be while Polly wants to show off some of her favorite pocket worlds. Both girls are determined to make sure that their time together is as amazing as possible, until they realize all they need to have fun is to be together.

Clinging to his last “kid” birthday, Nic celebrates his twelfth birthday by throwing a series of kid parties that culminate in a bash at his favorite place: Area Fifty None! When Nic makes a wish for his kid party to last forever, his wish accidentally summons the nefarious Party Animal, who grants Nic’s wish in exchange for a curse. Nic must break the curse or else he’ll become a Party Animal…

Polly and Shani are eager to beat their so-called “nemesis” Augustus Von Uberrich at the Littleton boat race until they discover a lost baby dolphin! To reunite the dolphin with her pod, Polly and Shani must find a way to stop the noisy and impossibly fast engines on Augustus’ boat before the dolphin loses her pod for good.

Polly’s adventures and rescue missions keep her busy. So when Polly visits the Sparkle Cove Council and hears about all their fun adventure and parties, she can’t help feeling like she’s missed out. But when someone activates sleep pockite she finds herself trapped in a dream world and must face her fear of missing out on all their adventures. She realizes that some adventures are worth missing…

Lately, Shani’s life has been loud. From Saryah’s crying to Shani’s noisy robot from Robotics Club, things can get a little rowdy in the Smith house! But when Captain Collywobbles goes missing, needing a break from all of the noise, Shani finds that sometimes the key to figuring things out is being quiet.

When Lila becomes a spokes-kid for a diabetes organization, she thinks she needs to know everything about diabetes. But as she journeys through the fantastical world of Castles & Unicorns to find the All-Knowing Scepter which will give her complete knowledge on any topic, she’ll learn the importance of being able to admit when she doesn’t know something.

When a video of Shani and dog-Lila dancing gets accidentally posted online, the Pocket Adoption Agency is flooded with calls asking for dancing pets. Determined to get as many pets adopted as possible, Shani tries to teach the animals to dance. After getting caught up trying to prove the animals’ talent to a local pet influencer, Shani realizes that the animals are happier showing off their…

While visiting Unicorn Land; Polly, Shani, and Nic discover the super fun Unicornicopia holiday is annually disturbed by a pack of pranking Uni-Bunnies! After discovering the ability to transform into one of these Uni-Bunnies himself, Nic is psyched to foil the Uni-Bunny’s plot with his newfound pranking powers. But he soon makes an unexpected discovery that makes him realize his true power is…

Polly, Shani, and Lila go to Unicorn Land for a spa day at Madame Keke Corn’s Elegant Horn Salon. But when the trend seeking adventure of the day involves a special pink hair dye which is causing an eco-disaster, Lila, Polly and Shani must convince the citizens of Unicorn Land to find a more sustainable means to get their fashion fix.

It’s day three of the Unicornicopia Celebration, which is traditionally celebrated by the unicorns with a big pool party. But when Shani and Polly get there, they find the pool has been sabotaged! Shani and Polly decide to bring the Unicorns to their world instead for the ultimate water park party! Although some unicorns may feel like Polly and Shani don’t belong at their pool party, the Smith…

When Shani wins Unicornicopia’s Dance-Off, she entrusts her Trophy to Polly who accidentally breaks it. Luckily, she has the Gold Pockite so she rewinds time. But when the Trophy keeps breaking in ridiculous ways, she keeps rewinding time over and over again. It isn’t until the Gold Pockite malfunctions and a Uni-Dragon statue awakens, that Polly learns that the only way to fix a mistake is to…

Polly and friends are excited to join the unicorns for the final celebrations of Unicornicopia but the party is pooped by Friscilla who takes power in Unicorn Land by stealing pockite from the all-powerful rainbow flower. Intent on never letting, Polly and her friends in Unicorn Land ever again she tries to break the Golden Door Handle! After they scuffle over the handle, the worst happens and…

With the help of a cryptic riddle and Jake's teleportation powers, Polly and her friends and allies must travel through various pockite worlds to find a way back to Unicorn World and free their friends’ from Friscilla’s tyrannical reign. It’s an epic quest where friends throughout the season join to together to do what’s right in our season finale episode!
